minutes.headline: Commission chose to contact the owner of the neglected 50 Main St church before any cease and desist order.
minutes.summary: The commission discussed demolition by neglect at the former Methodist Church at 50 Main Street and agreed a member would approach the owner first. It also discussed volunteer restoration of the Town Pound and ownership of that parcel. Most of the meeting reviewed a redrafted determination of applicability application, including dropping fees and adding a questionnaire. No substantive vote was audible.

The chair will ask the town clerk about eliminating the fee, electronic filing and simultaneous routing to the commission.
A member will draft a questionnaire to replace the open-ended evaluation questions on the application.

what_happened.line: The commission agreed that a member will contact the owner of the neglected former Methodist Church at 50 Main Street and report back before any invitation or cease and desist.
Members will check with the assessor and land use staff whether the town owns the Town Pound parcel before any volunteer restoration plan goes forward.
The commission reviewed a redrafted determination of applicability application and leaned toward dropping the initial filing fee, pending a check with the town clerk.
A member will draft a questionnaire to replace the open-ended evaluation questions on the application, and the chair will ask the clerk about electronic filing.
No substantive vote was audible; the next meeting was set for April 4th.

why_it_matters: The approach to the owner of 50 Main Street is the first step on a building the commission describes as neglected, and it sets whether the matter moves toward enforcement.
Changes to the application, including a possible end to the filing fee and a questionnaire, would change what a property owner must file and pay to get a historic review.
watch_next: Report back from the member who contacts the 50 Main Street owner, expected at a coming meeting.
Next commission meeting on April 4th, with the clerk's answer on the fee and electronic filing.
